capabilities: Collect sync logs from the vault
Match log lines against 22 failure signatures
Redact tokens, passwords, e-mails and paths before matching
Produce a report with fix steps and upstream issue links
Export the report as a note or as JSON
disambiguation: Not a sync engine or repair tool; it only reads existing logs and reports which known failure matched and how to fix it.
extras: No network calls or telemetry; redaction runs before matching and again when the report is rendered. Only Remotely Save and Self-hosted LiveSync are supported, the rules are static, and a paid hosted tier is described as not built yet.
problem: Sync errors show up as cryptic console lines, leaving users to dig through hundreds of upstream GitHub issues to guess which failure applies to them.

relations.evidence: Supports Remotely Save and Self-hosted LiveSync.
Supports Remotely Save and Self-hosted LiveSync.
Install the Logstravaganza plugin (the approach the Remotely Save docs recommend on iOS)

summary: Local health check that scans vault sync logs, matches them against 22 known failure signatures, and produces a redacted report with fix steps.
